title.text: Limit Hold'em Trainer — v1 storyboards (low-fidelity, sample data)

q1.text:
Splash — open questions
• Show splash on every launch, or only while loading (skip if ready in < 1 s)?
• App name: keep "Limit Hold'em Trainer" or choose another?
• Auto-continue to Home, or wait for a click?

q2.text:
Home — open questions
• Only one paused session at a time, or several?
• What shows on first launch (no sessions yet)?
• Is the last-session snapshot wanted here?

q3.text:
Game Config — open questions
• Stakes: which limit levels to offer? Play money only (chips shown as $)?
• Cash buy-in / rebuy rules; SNG starting chips and how fast limits rise.
• Pick each bot's style per seat, or choose a preset line-up?
• Remember last config as the default?

q4.text:
Table — open questions
• Hint: show the answer straight away, or a nudge first?
• Show opponents' style labels at the table (helps learning) or hide them (more realistic)?
• Action log always visible, or collapsible?
• Keyboard shortcuts for Fold / Call / Raise?

q5.text:
Hand Review — open questions
• Open automatically after every hand, only after hands with an error, or only on click?
• Show opponents' hole cards that were mucked (not shown at showdown)?
• Grade the bots' decisions too, or only yours?

q6.text:
Session Report — open questions
• Which 5 style stats count for goal G-4?
• Minimum hands before a leak is reported (avoid noise)?
• When does a session end: on Leave only, or also after inactivity?

q7.text:
Statistics — open questions
• Group trends by session, by day, or by every 100 hands?
• Filter by table size / game type?
• Show goal targets (G-2, G-3, G-4) on the charts?

q8.text:
Settings — open questions
• Two-colour or four-colour deck option?
• Show amounts in $ or in big bets?
• Reset all data: confirm with a typed word or a simple dialog?
